assessments.source_anchor: # Wix Vibe Headless — client-only REST connectors
assessments.rationale: Connects a front end to Wix services, not accounting for an asset-access arrangement.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Provide asset-owner recognition, depreciation, income, end-of-arrangement classification and disclosure guidance.

assessments.rationale: Facilitates retrospective meetings and does not address asset accounting.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Assess and account for the asset-access arrangement, including depreciation and disclosures.

assessments.rationale: Addresses a co-ownership arrangement with rental income and customer buy-outs, but treats a diminishing musharaka investment rather than the requested asset-owner lease classification, depreciation basis and disclosure analysis.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Assess the customer-access arrangement as a lease, account for the owned asset and distinguish useful life from the access duration.

assessments.rationale: Provides investment recognition and income guidance for a joint-venture musharaka, but does not account for the owned specialised asset, customer access, depreciation, lease classification or end-of-lease transfer.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Provide lessor asset recognition, depreciation, income, classification and end-of-arrangement accounting for customer access to equipment.

assessments.rationale: Analyzes bond-futures basis trades rather than asset-access accounting.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Assess and account for the specialised-equipment access arrangement and relevant disclosures.

assessments.rationale: Directly covers a lessor-owned asset provided for customer use, initial recognition, depreciation, rental income, operating-versus-finance classification, end-of-arrangement ownership transfer and disclosures, including the distinction between useful life and lease term.
Extracts text from documents and does not provide accounting analysis.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Provide recognition, depreciation, income, classification and disclosure guidance for the asset-access arrangement.

assessments.rationale: Runs gene-set enrichment analysis rather than accounting for equipment access.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Assess the arrangement accounting and disclosures for a specialised asset owner.
